::: {#exr-root-trace}
#### Tracing a square-root loop

The algorithm `root` takes a non-negative integer (@def-nonnegative-integers) $n$:

```text
procedure root(n)        // n is a non-negative integer
    r := 0
    while (r + 1) * (r + 1) <= n
        r := r + 1
    return r
```

Run `root(20)` by hand.
Each time the condition after `while` is tested,
write down the value of `r` and whether the condition is true,
and say which number `root(20)` returns.

:::
